HideWarningProceedButton.title: Hide Warning Proceed Button
HideWarningProceedButton.description: If true, the warning page proceed button is hidden.

HideWarningReportButton.title: Hide Warning Report Button
HideWarningReportButton.description: If true, the warning page report button is hidden.

LockUserAllowlist.title: Lock User Allowlist
LockUserAllowlist.description: If true, the user cannot edit or clear the allowed websites list, but existing entries still apply.

LockProviderSettings.title: Lock Provider Settings
LockProviderSettings.description: If true, provider toggles and provider settings are locked in the options page.

DisableSettingsReset.title: Disable Settings Reset
DisableSettingsReset.description: If true, reset actions in the settings page are disabled.

DisableThirdPartyProviders.title: Disable Third-Party Providers
DisableThirdPartyProviders.description: If true, third-party providers are disabled and cannot be enabled from settings.

MetaDefenderApiKey.title: MetaDefender API Key
MetaDefenderApiKey.description: Managed API key for the MetaDefender integrations.

HideProviderControls.title: Hide Provider Controls
HideProviderControls.description: If true, provider controls are hidden from the popup and options page.

ManagedAllowlist.title: Managed Allowlist
ManagedAllowlist.description: Host or URL patterns that are always treated as safe. The end user cannot remove these. Examples: "intranet.example.com", "*.corp.example.com", "https://apps.example.com/portal".

ManagedBlocklist.title: Managed Blocklist
ManagedBlocklist.description: Host or URL patterns that are always blocked, evaluated before the threat providers run. Examples: "bad.example.com", "*.malware.example", "https://phish.example/login".

ProxyBaseUrl.title: Proxy Base URL
ProxyBaseUrl.description: Overrides the backend origin the extension sends lookups to. Must be an http(s) origin, for example "https://osprey.msp.example". When empty, the default public backend is used.

ProxyApiKey.title: Proxy API Key
ProxyApiKey.description: Per-tenant API key presented to a self-hosted proxy as the X-Osprey-Tenant-Key header on every lookup. Only sent when ProxyBaseUrl is set, so the key is never sent to the public backend. When empty, no key is sent.

DeviceTag.title: Device Tag
DeviceTag.description: Opaque identifier for this endpoint, attached to reported events by later features. Has no visible effect on its own.

SiteId.title: Site ID
SiteId.description: Opaque identifier for the client organization this endpoint belongs to, attached to reported events by later features. Has no visible effect on its own.

DisableUserAllowlist.title: Disable User Allowlist
DisableUserAllowlist.description: If true, the end user cannot add any allowlist entries or exclusions, and existing user allowlist entries are ignored.

ManagedProviderSettings.title: Managed Provider Settings
ManagedProviderSettings.description: Per-provider overrides keyed by provider id. Each value may set "enabled" (boolean, the managed enabled state for the provider), "bypassBlockingThreshold" (boolean), "requestTimeoutMs" (integer between 1000 and 60000), and "blockCategories" (an object mapping a category key to a boolean).

BrandLogoUrl.title: Brand Logo URL
BrandLogoUrl.description: Image URL or data: image string used for the logo on the warning page and popup. When empty, the default Osprey logo is shown.

BrandName.title: Brand Name
BrandName.description: Name shown in the warning page banner and popup, replacing the default Osprey product name. When empty, the default name is shown.

SupportUrl.title: Support URL
SupportUrl.description: Support or help-desk URL shown as a contact link on the warning page and popup. Must be an http(s) URL, for example "https://help.msp.example". When empty, no support link is shown.

SupportEmail.title: Support Email
SupportEmail.description: Support email address shown as a contact link on the warning page. When empty, no email link is shown.

CustomWarningMessage.title: Custom Warning Message
CustomWarningMessage.description: Optional override for the lead sentence on the warning page. When empty, the default warning message is shown.

ManagedConfigUrl.title: Managed Config URL
ManagedConfigUrl.description: An http(s) URL to a JSON configuration document the extension fetches on startup and on a schedule. Values from the document are merged UNDER managed storage: anything an admin sets locally here always wins, and the document fills in the rest. On a fetch failure the last successfully fetched document is kept, so a network outage never drops settings. The document may also define custom threat providers. When empty, no remote configuration is fetched. This key can only be set through managed storage; a fetched document cannot change it.

ReportingEndpoint.title: Reporting Endpoint
ReportingEndpoint.description: An http(s) URL the extension POSTs detection and override events and periodic health heartbeats to. When empty, no events or heartbeats are sent. Example: "https://reporting.msp.example/osprey".

ReportingAuthToken.title: Reporting Auth Token
ReportingAuthToken.description: Optional bearer token sent as the Authorization header on every reporting request. When set, each POST carries "Authorization: Bearer <token>". When empty, no Authorization header is sent.
